Chapter 590: Chapter 26 On the Brink of Collapse (Please Subscribe)

“Yes, Your Holiness, what exactly happened?”

The other members of the Longshan Family were also somewhat puzzled.

They absolutely trusted Lin Yuan,

but just moments ago, hundreds of True Self Incarnations were about to arrive, and the demise of the Longshan Family seemed imminent.

Now there’s no danger?

The situation had changed too quickly.

...

“What happened…”

The Rank Pope remained silent.

His mind replayed the scene where Lin Yuan had simply inhaled gently, and all the ‘mesons’ within his palm crumbled and merged into his mouth.

One must know, those ‘mesons’ were True God Incarnations! Among them, some Upper-Rank God Incarnations were scarcely weaker than normal True Gods.

Yet, they had met such an end.

The Rank Pope’s heart trembled a bit, feeling somewhat relieved that he had not acted earlier because, otherwise, even if he had not died, he would likely have been brushed aside by Lin Yuan.

“How could the Longshan Patriarch be so powerful?” The Rank Pope looked up at the sky.

There, numerous stars hung, marking the territories of the Divine Kingdom of the Gods of Light’s Ocean and the Dark Abyss.

The number of gods is limited, so the Divine Kingdoms are also limited, and the stars in the sky are just as finite.

In this world, some Demigods tread carefully, secretly gathering faith, perhaps evading the perception of the gods.

But once they take that step and become True Gods, raising their own Divine Kingdom, there is no way to hide it.

Because Divine Kingdoms are too conspicuous, turned into stars, suspended high above in the sky, and the number is just so many, each new one will surely attract the attention of the gods.

However, in recent centuries, even millennia, there hasn’t been an additional star in the sky.

That is to say, no new deities have been born.

From this one can infer that the Longshan Patriarch has not yet become a deity, at least he hasn’t raised a Divine Kingdom.

But without raising a Divine Kingdom, without the power of a Divine Kingdom, why is the Longshan Patriarch so strong?

The Rank Pope felt his understanding shattering, how could the Longshan Patriarch, not a deity, kill gods as if they were mere ants?

…

The Rank Pope steadied himself, gathered his thoughts, and looked towards the puzzled Longshan Ling and several other core members of the Longshan Family.

“What the Longshan Patriarch said is true.”

“There’s no longer any danger.”

The Rank Pope said with difficulty.

Danger?

All the danger had been consumed by the Longshan Patriarch in one gulp.

“Ah?”

“It’s really safe now?”

While Longshan Ling and the others sighed in relief, their curiosity grew even more.

“Those True God Incarnations were all resolved by the Longshan Patriarch; those ‘mesons’ in the Patriarch’s palm just now were those True God Incarnations.”

After a moment of silence, the Rank Pope patiently explained.

He had a premonition that after today, the reputation of the Longshan Patriarch would resound through the Light’s Ocean and the Dark Abyss.

“Those things were True God Incarnations?”

Longshan Ling and the others went into a daze, “True God Incarnations are so weak?”

As soon as the last sentence was spoken, they realized the truth.

It was not that the True God Incarnations were weak, but that their Patriarch was too strong. Compared to him, the mighty and invincible True God Incarnations appeared pitifully frail.

“I must leave now.”

In the end, the Rank Pope cast a deep glance into the Longshan Great Hall, and then turned and left.

What he had witnessed was too unbelievable, and he needed to report to the Main God of Rank immediately.

In fact, he didn’t need to report; the matter simply couldn’t be kept secret, and the original True Gods whose deific incarnations were consumed by Lin Yuan were already in an uproar.

This incident would spread at a terrifying speed among the gods, and not only within the Ocean of Light.

…

The Ocean of Light.

Inside the serpentine and coiling palace.

Hundreds of True Gods looked at each other in shock, the amazement in their hearts nearly overflowing.

“My divine incarnation is dead.”

“Same here, I can’t sense it at all anymore.”

“That enormous face that appeared last, doesn’t it resemble the Patriarch of the Longshan Family?”

“It’s not just resemblance, it must be the Longshan Patriarch.”

As True Gods of the Eight Layer, their memories would not fail them—if that enormous face were reduced by a billion times, it would be that of the Longshan Patriarch.

Moreover, their divine incarnations were en route to Longshan Ling to question the Longshan Patriarch for his crimes and were taken to the Spatial Prison.

Multiple clues converged, pointing towards a possibility.

It was the Longshan Patriarch himself who had acted against them.

The one they regarded as an ant, whose soul they intended to burn in their Divine Kingdom for ten thousand years, was just a mere Demigod.

Truth be told, the gods had never taken the Longshan Patriarch seriously, even though he was behind the disappearance of Demigods these years.

After all, a Demigod is just that, a Demigod.

No matter how powerful, as long as one hasn’t gathered faith and raised a Divine Kingdom, they are still an ant.

But now.

The ant in the eyes of the gods had suddenly transformed into a towering dragon?

“Impossible.”

“How can he be this strong without becoming a god?”

“Yes, the Longshan Patriarch isn’t even a True God, how could he possibly be this powerful?”

Despite the overwhelming evidence, there were still True Gods who couldn’t believe it.

They had gone through countless trials and tribulations, and with great difficulty, raised their Divine Kingdoms and entered the Ocean of Light, becoming deities exalted by all living beings.

And then this happened?

“I must see the Prime God to understand the reason behind this, how exactly is the Longshan Patriarch so powerful?”

“Right, but which Prime God should we go to?”

“Let’s go to the God of Divination. There’s nothing in the world he doesn’t know about; the God of Divination must be aware of the origins of the Longshan Patriarch.”

One by one, the True Gods rose to their feet.
